Use Case: Service & infra metrics, alerting on rates/percentiles
Strengths: CNCF graduated, PromQL is powerful, huge exporter ecosystem
Weaknesses: Single-node TSDB; long-term storage requires Cortex/Mimir/Thanos/VictoriaMetrics
Notes: Use 'recording rules' for expensive queries; cardinality explosion is the #1 ops issue.

Strengths: HA, horizontal scale, cheap object-storage backend
Keywords: mimir cortex thanos victoriametrics ha tsdb
Notes: VictoriaMetrics is the simplest single-binary option; Mimir scales the furthest.

Weaknesses: Alerting rules can sprawl across teams
Integrations: Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, ClickHouse, datadog, etc.
Notes: Manage dashboards as code (provisioned via files / GitOps), not via UI clicks.

Strengths: Cheap object-storage backend, LogQL mirrors PromQL
Notes: Index by service/level/region only; do NOT index high-cardinality fields like user-id.
OpenSearch is the AWS / community fork after Elastic licence change.

Strengths: Tempo: cheap object-store backend; Jaeger/Zipkin: mature ecosystems
Notes: Use tail-based sampling for production; head-based at high-volume edges.

Strengths: Single API across languages, pluggable exporters, future-proof
Weaknesses: Spec still evolving for logs/profiling; ecosystem maturity varies by language
Integrations: Prometheus, Tempo, Loki, Jaeger, Datadog, NewRelic, etc.
Notes: Standardise on OTel SDKs + OTel Collector to avoid vendor lock-in.

Strengths: Find prod bottlenecks impossible to reproduce locally
Weaknesses: Overhead must be tuned; eBPF version requires recent kernels
Keywords: pyroscope parca profiling flame graph ebpf
Notes: Pyroscope (now in Grafana) merged with Phlare; eBPF profiler runs unmodified binaries.

Strengths: Best-of-breed UX, fast to onboard, deep integrations
Weaknesses: Cost can dominate cloud bill; cardinality limits
Notes: Set per-team budgets and use 'metric volumes' alerts to catch cost spikes.

Tool: New Relic / Honeycomb / Dynatrace / Splunk Observability
Strengths: Honeycomb pioneered high-cardinality wide events; New Relic free tier; Dynatrace AIOps
Notes: Honeycomb's BubbleUp / Heatmap UX is unmatched for debugging unknown unknowns.

Strengths: Best-in-class error grouping, releases, source maps; performance traces
Notes: Tag errors with 'release' + 'environment' to enable regression detection.

Use Case: Tail logs from nodes/containers and forward
Strengths: Tiny footprint, no JVM (vs Logstash); rich processors
Notes: Vector (Rust) by Datadog is the most modern; Fluent Bit is CNCF & ubiquitous on K8s.

Weaknesses: Cost (PD/Opsgenie); Grafana OnCall is OSS but younger
Notes: Define error budgets first; only page on user-impacting SLO burn, not raw thresholds.
